test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"rivalry."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Rivalry"** means competition or conflict between two or more parties. (प्रतिद्वंद्वित, प्रतिस्‍पर्धा (व्‍यक्तियों, समूहों आदि में)) • It is often used to describe a situation where two people, groups, or organizations are competing for the same thing. • **Example**: *The **rivalry**__ between two companies in the same industry can be intense.* • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: At the core of the __epic__ lies the fierce __rivalry__ between two branches of the Kuru dynasty, the Pandavas and the Kauravas. The lifelong struggle ______ (3) ______ the cousins for the throne of Hastinapur Culminates ______ (4) ______ bloody battle of Kurukshetra, in which ______ (5) ______ kings of that period participated and perished. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Commute"** means to travel regularly between one's place of work and home. (प्रतिदिन निवास स्‍थान से कार्य-स्‍थान तक यात्रा करना) • **"Hostile"** means unfriendly or aggressive. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति अत्‍यंत उग्र भावनाओं वाला; प्रतिकूल भाव) • **"Friendship"** means a close relationship between two people based on mutual trust, affection, and support. (मित्रता; दोस्‍ती) 1b1:T1157, The correct answer is **"between."**
